summary: Checks build, vet, and test all pass and the revision can fast-forward origin/master. Blocking review findings: (1) ledger_aggregate.go ledgerAggregatesHuman prints agent.Agent without oneLine, so a ledger identity containing a newline forges an extra human status line; reproduced with agent="builder\nINJECTED" which printed an unlabelled INJECTED row. Existing runRecordHuman and recentFailuresHuman sanitize this value, so the new path regresses that invariant. (2) doctor.go doctorPowderCheck reads POWDER_AGENT/POWDER_URL from the process environment instead of the service environment file it is meant to validate, while doctorOpenRouterKeyCheck reads the same file. Reproduced: with POWDER_AGENT/POWDER_URL present only in the service env file and unset in the process, doctor reports powder_reachability ok as 'POWDER_AGENT is not set; Powder selection is disabled', so the documented deployment check can pass without validating configured Powder. (3) doctor.go runs gh/powder subprocess probes under context.Background() with no timeout, so an unreachable or hung gh or powder can make forest doctor hang indefinitely; only the OpenRouter HTTP probe is bounded.
